model_annotation: Figure 3(a) displays a line plot illustrating the loss values over the number of training steps for different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Training steps,” is plotted on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10^3 to 10^6, with tick marks at intervals of 10^3. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is plotted on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes five distinct lines, each representing a different model variant: “Vanilla” (blue, solid line), “SrmLLM (n=64)” (red, dashed line), “SrmLLM (n=128)” (green, dash-dotted line), “SrmLLM (n=256)” (purple, dotted line), and “SrmLLM (n=380)” (orange, solid line). The “Vanilla” line starts at a loss value of approximately 0.8 and decreases to about 0.45. The “SrmLLM (n=64)” line begins at approximately 0.75 and decreases to about 0.5. The “SrmLLM (n=128)” line starts at approximately 0.7 and decreases to about 0.55. The “SrmLLM (n=256)” line begins at approximately 0.75 and decreases to about 0.5. The “SrmLLM (n=380)” line starts at approximately 0.7 and decreases to about 0.55. All lines exhibit a general downward trend, indicating a reduction in loss as training progresses.
